main_text.notes: Printed text is clear except where marked [?]. The initial A of "Abdicare" is the woodcut letter. "Adnocatus" and "Iz." are doubtful as printed. The page number is stylised and read as 993 with a doubt. Long s is normalised to s, and the words "fignificat" and "vt" are corrected to "significat" and "ut". Lower half of the right column continues on the next page.
